title: Entryway
brief: Short outdoor-tech teach map: spawn facing a triangular stair overlook into a yard, clear light zombies, optional side rooms for shotgun and secrets, then a compact indoor exit. Almost no gating—learn doors, stairs, pickups, peek fights, and curiosity rewards.
pacing_notes: Lowest intensity map: safe visual read, light former-humans, secrets for explorers, exit within 30s par.

part_designs.shape: small elevated ledge looking down a triangle of stairs
part_designs.elevation: spawn floor above yard; stairs step down in clear STEP textures
part_designs.cover: none at spawn—full sightline into the lesson space
part_designs.mobs: zombiemen already visible in the yard (threat telegraph)
part_designs.textures: tech / outdoor rock; sky ceiling on yard
part_designs.audio_props: open sky feel; Running from Evil
part_designs.detail: First frame teaches height + stairs + enemies in view before the player moves.

part_designs.shape: wide triangular stair wedge, not a choke
part_designs.elevation: multi-step drop using dedicated STEP risers
part_designs.mobs: none on stairs; fights wait in yard
part_designs.detail: Stairs are the landmark and the path; elevation is readable and rewarded with STEPs.
Breathing room after spawn; player chooses which door to sample.

part_designs.elevation: same floor as yard or one step
part_designs.detail: Weapon teach without forcing combat peak; optional but strongly signaled.

part_designs.triggers: use on dissimilar wall, or jump secret
part_designs.detail: Rewards curiosity; Entryway seeds the idea that not every wall is honest.

part_designs.shape: short indoor corridor to exit door/switch
part_designs.elevation: indoor ceil lower than sky yard for contrast
part_designs.detail: Clear end-of-line read: leave outdoor landmark, enter tighter tech, finish.

design_lessons: Secrets as curiosity, not mandatory keys
Contrast outdoor sky vs indoor ceil
